subject.title: [Bug]: openclaw doctor --fix 4-5x slower on 2026.5.20 vs 2026.5.19 (55s → 229s+) — session snapshot path traversal bottleneck

question: Should this issue remain open behind the blocked repair-sequencing candidate, be replaced with a narrower measured optimization, or be closed only after current-release live timing proof?
rationale: Current source proves only a partial snapshot repair is shipped; deciding whether existing release timing is sufficient or whether to sponsor/replace the risky open optimization requires maintainer judgment and proof from a real multi-session setup.

options.title: Keep Open For Proof

options.title: Close With Live Timing Evidence
